header.running_head: The Ansaar in the Battles against the Banu Qaynuqah, Banu Nadheer and Banu Qurayzah Tribes

blocks.text:
march for battle. As they passed by the Banu Ghanam tribe who lived in the neighbourhood of the Masjid, Rasulullaah ﷺ asked them if anyone had passed by them. They told him that Hadhrat Dihya Kalbi (RA) had passed by. The beard, age and face of Hadhrat Jibra'eel (AS) resembled that of Hadhrat Dihya Kalbi (RA) (because Hadhrat Jibra'eel (AS) appeared in the semblance of Hadhrat Dihya (RA). It was therefore Hadhrat Jibra'eel (AS) whom the Banu Ghanam tribesmen had seen passing). When Rasulullaah ﷺ arrived at the fortresses of the Banu Qurayza, he laid siege to them for twenty-five nights.
When the Banu Qurayza could no longer bear the siege and their suffering grew intense, they were asked to surrender to the decision of Rasulullaah ﷺ. When they consulted with Hadhrat Abu Lubaba (RA), he indicated to them that they would be killed. They then asked to surrender to the decision of Hadhrat Sa'd bin Mu'aadh (RA). Rasulullaah ﷺ allowed them to do so and Hadhrat Sa'd bin Mu'aadh (RA) was brought on a donkey fitted with a carriage made from the bark of a date palm. He was lifted on to the donkey and his people surrounded him. (Interceding on behalf of the Banu Qurayza) The people said to Hadhrat Sa'd (RA), "O Abu Amr! They are your allies, your friends, they are of assistance during times of need and people whom you know." However, Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) gave no reply and did not even pay any attention to them.
Eventually, when he drew close to the settlement of the Banu Qurayza, Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) turned to his people and said, "The time has come for me not to be concerned about the criticism of critics when it concerns Allaah." Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) narrates further from Hadhrat Abu Sa'eed Khudri (RA) that when Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) arrived, Rasulullaah ﷺ said to the Sahabah (RA), "Stand up for your leader and help him to dismount." Hadhrat Umar (RA) remarked, "Our leader is Allaah." Rasulullaah ﷺ repeated, "Help him down." After the Sahabah (RA) had helped Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) down, Rasulullaah ﷺ said to him, "Decide their fate." Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) said, "I have decided that all their warriors should be executed, that their families should be taken captive and that their wealth be distributed as booty." Rasulullaah ﷺ commented, "You have decided their fate according to the decision of Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ."
Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) then made the following du'aa, "O Allaah! If you have reserved any battle for your Nabi ﷺ against the Quraysh, then preserve me for it. However, if You have terminated all battles between him and them, then take me to You." Although his wound had already healed by then and the only sign of it was a mark resembling an earring, it opened up again. He then had to return to the tent that Rasulullaah ﷺ had pitched for him in the Masjid. Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) narrates further, "Rasulullaah ﷺ, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and Hadhrat Umar (RA) went to visit him. I swear by the Being in Whose control is the life of Muhammad ﷺ!
